author: Casey Williams
work_completed: Replaced HP filter element. Cleaned strainer. Topped up hydraulic oil (18L Shell Tellus S2 M46).
issues_identified: Elevated return-line temp (78°C · normal <65°C). Filter delta-P alarm cleared post-replacement but temp remains high. Suspecting internal bypass on main pump.
actions_taken: Filter replaced. Oil sampled and sent to lab. Temp logged at 15-min intervals.
parts_used: HP filter element x1, 18L Shell Tellus S2 M46
delays: 45 min waiting on permit reissue after isolation checks
planned_next: Await oil sample results. If pump internal wear confirmed, schedule replacement in next 2-3 shifts before catastrophic failure.
recommendations: Increase temp monitoring frequency. Consider pre-emptive pump swap.

author: Casey Williams
work_completed: Bearing temperature check on drive-end. Grease service. Belt tension check.
issues_identified: DE bearing running 4°C above baseline. Not critical but trending up over last 3 shifts.
actions_taken: Grease serviced (2 shots Mobilith SHC 220). Thermal image captured. Trend logged.
planned_next: Continue thermal monitoring. Schedule bearing inspection next major service window (est. 300 hours).
recommendations: Order replacement bearing SKF 22320 to have on-site.

author: Ryan Porteous
work_completed: Diagnosed rotation head oil leak. Isolated + tagged out. Ordered replacement seal kit.
issues_identified: Major hydraulic leak at rotation head. ~40L lost. Safety hazard.
actions_taken: Isolation applied. Spill cleaned + reported to environmental team. Seal kit ordered from Sandvik (48hr lead).
delays: Rig down 48+ hours awaiting seal kit
planned_next: Fit new seal kit on Monday shift. Recommission + test before returning to production.
recommendations: Review rotation head service interval — this is 3rd seal failure in 12 months.

actions_taken: Data logged to CBM system. Flagged for follow-up.
